description: This file defines the PHP class 'TemplateEmail', which extends 'TemplateText'. It provides a method to generate an HTML email link based on an email address, used within the SuiteCRM project as a template for email fields.

classes.name: TemplateEmail
classes.description: A class representing an email template that generates a mailto hyperlink for email fields.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns an HTML anchor tag with a mailto link for the email address, using the uppercase form of the class property 'name'.
